description: Reverses a list of readings with Kotlin's reversed
JavaScript's toReversed returns a copy and leaves the list in order
An undo history reads the newest edit first as edits arrive
A class population reversed lists the latest instance first
code:
class Visit(room):
    this.room = room
Visit("lab")
Visit("hall")
recent = Visit.reversed()
Visit("roof")
recent.map(visit -> visit.room)

description: Each train lists its cars from the rear in a class-level rule
code:
class Train(cars):
    this.cars = cars
$Train.fromRear = $Train.cars.toReversed()
local = Train(["engine", "coach"])
local.cars.push("caboose")
local.fromRear

description: Reverses a word with accents character by character
Ruby's reverse keeps an emoji whole in a string
A class-level rule flags the palindromes among words
code:
class Word(text):
    this.text = text
$Word.palindrome = $Word.text.toLowerCase().reversed() == $Word.text.toLowerCase()
words = [Word("Level"), Word("kayaks"), Word("Anna")]
words.map(word -> word.palindrome)

description: Nested lists keep their own order when the outer list is reversed
Empty lists and empty strings reverse to empty values
Arguments are evaluated and ignored as the accepted reverse ignores them
A list read from a state version reverses without writing history
A value snapshot reversed stays frozen as the list grows
A try that caught the former error now receives the reversed list
code:
result = ""
try:
    result = [1, 2].reversed()
catch error:
    result = "caught"
result

description: On a class name the population alias wins over an instance method
code:
class Team(name):
    this.name = name
    def reversed(): return this.name + "!"
red = Team("red")
Team("blue")
[red.reversed(), Team.reversed().map(team -> team.name)]

description: A failing reader of a reversed list rolls back the push
code:
def latest(log):
    if log.length > 2:
        throw "FULL"
    return log
entries = ["boot", "sync"]
recent = latest(entries.reversed())
failure = ""
try:
    entries.push("scan")
catch error:
    failure = error
[failure, entries, recent]
